verdict.rationale: Otter's own materials claim 'speaker recognition' alongside live transcription and list 'taggable speakers' as a plan feature. Together these suggest diarization plus the ability to attach real names to speakers. Both are single-line marketing or pricing mentions with no detail on how names get matched or how accurate attribution is. missing for 10: documentation of automatic real-name matching (e.g., voice profiles or calendar-participant mapping) versus manual tagging, evidence of diarization accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration of correct speaker attribution.
